cohort: 58 women with Takayasu arteritis (TAK), primarily recruited from a population-based cohort in southeast Norway
finding: In this population-based cohort of women with TAK, pregnancy outcomes were generally favorable, with no significant differences in miscarriages, induced abortions, or maternal complications between pregnancies before and after TAK onset.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were more frequent in deliveries after TAK onset (42%) compared to the general population (11%).
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery in pregnancies after TAK onset was 37.5 weeks
